title: Lynk and Omnispace merger creates D2D challenger Elveo Mobile
summary: D2D satellite operators Lynk and Omnispace complete merger and rebrand as Elveo Mobile, with plans for 320 LEO satellites and services starting in early 2028.

title: NYSE warns Optimum about stock price
summary: The New York Stock Exchange warned Optimum Communications that its common stock price has dropped below a 30 trading-day period, giving it six months to regain compliance. #pressrelease

title: FCC broadband study points to broader service reach, faster speeds
summary: The FCC's latest annual Section 706 report finds that competition is helping to fuel broader expansion of broadband services and faster data speeds. #pressrelease

title: Rogers offers free D2D to customers impacted by wildfires
summary: Canada's Rogers Communications is providing free satellite connectivity to mobile devices to all British Columbia amid spreading wildfires in the region. #pressrelease

title: California PUC stamps Charter-Cox merger, with conditions
summary: The CPUC has approved the Charter-Cox deal with an array of conditions. The stamp sets the stage for the deal's closing and the creation of the world's largest cable operator.

title: China Mobile earnings fall as new tax continues to bite
summary: The AI business of China Mobile is struggling to get traction while its legacy business shows signs of shrinkage.

title: Heather McCallion named COO of Cable One
summary: Heather McCallion is set to join Cable One as COO later this month. She most recently served as chief experience officer at WideOpenWest. #pressrelease

title: Study pours more cold water on SpaceX's small cell plan
summary: Research firm MoffettNathanson flags a host of challenges for SpaceX's small cell plan, arguing the 'bull case' hinges on SpaceX locking down an MVNO deal.

title: The Buildout: Hawaii to start BEAD builds as Texas stalls
summary: This week in broadband builds: Hawaiian Telcom signs BEAD contract; Texas halts BEAD funding; GoNetspeed commences construction in Rahway, New Jersey; Wire 3 invests another $40 million in Georgia – and more.

title: Keppel obtains Singapore license for Kruger Cable System project
summary: The license enables Keppel to move toward making a final investment decision on the proposed Kruger Cable System. The subsea system will connect Singapore, Malaysia, Bangladesh, India and Oman, with branches throughout South Asia.

title: Nokia quits R&D facility in China and cuts 1,600 jobs
summary: The closure of a Nokia facility in Hangzhou will lead to about 1,600 job cuts and comes after the Finnish vendor took full control of its China business.

title: Cisco must steel itself for the coming AI bust
summary: A nasty chain reaction detonated by the loss-making OpenAI and Anthropic could eventually catch up with Cisco.

title: California PUC approves Charter-Cox merger
summary: The California Public Utilities Commission has approved the Charter-Cox deal with conditions, including broadband for low-income households, digital inclusion dollars and at least $275 million toward network upgrades in the state.

title: Cable tech roundup: Network upgrade action, M&A pursuits
summary: Cable tech suppliers are seeing gains as operators move ahead with network upgrades. Meanwhile, Harmonic and Vistance Networks reiterated interest in pursuing strategic M&A.

title: Agentic AI and inference to supercharge front-end networks growth – Dell'Oro

title: Lockheed Martin preps drone detection service using Verizon 5G
summary: Lockheed Martin plans to offer a 5G drone detection service next year using Verizon's network and tech from Nvidia, ODC, Keysight and subsidiary Astris AI.

title: Telstra hikes earnings but faces questions over CEO pay rise
summary: Telstra increased its CEO's compensation by 11% after emergency triple-zero line outage; it emerges as the telco reports a 2.7% hike in full-year earnings.

title: East Longmeadow approves fiber funding against Spectrum's objections
summary: A Massachusetts town council voted to approve $43.5 million to fund a municipal fiber broadband network despite a plea from Spectrum to 'slow down' the process to advance the project.
